axiosDescription: Compare manual requests, throttling and debouncing, and inspect each response.
precisionDescription: Edit the numeric tags to explore decimal arithmetic and allocation. Examples use eight decimal places.
barcodeDescription: Compare sizing, colors and encoding formats. Edit the text to see the barcode update.
qrcodeDescription: Compare basic QR codes, loading states and reactive content.
formDescription: Fill in the sample form to try field validation, reset and submission.
modalDescription: Try draggable, full-screen, custom-width and programmatic dialogs.
directiveDescription: Try truncation, copying, ripples, disabling and event rate limiting in one place.
contextDescription: Right-click the area below to explore menu positioning and available actions.
iframeDescription: Compare lazy and eager iframes to see when external content loads.
cacheDescription: Enter a key and value to compare session and local storage.
flowDescription: Drag nodes to rearrange the graph and switch to read-only mode to compare behavior.
dragDescription: Open a floating card to compare starting positions and drag boundaries.
chartDescription: Explore chart themes, loading states and custom rendering.
detailDescription: This view adds a breadcrumb to the existing tab. Use navigation above to return to the list.
aboutDescription: See the project version, maintenance links and dependencies.
multiOneDescription: Switch between nested routes to observe view caching and form state.
multiOtherDescription: Open sibling views in the sidebar to inspect their breadcrumb hierarchy.
multiNestedDescription: Inspect navigation and view caching for a deeply nested route.
segmentDescription: Switch widths and sizes to see the capsule move across segments with icons, hints and disabled options.
segmentPopover: A contextual hint for this segment.
scrollDescription: Scroll to see cards fade and slide into view.
